title: Daemon fails on long checkout paths and every command pays a retry delay
description: In a deeply nested checkout the daemon exits with 'path must be shorter than SUN_LEN' for project/.cache/kanbus.sock. Each command then retries for about 0.6 s before falling back, and leaves zombie kbs processes. Worktrees make deep paths common. Use a short socket path (hashed under the runtime dir) and fail fast.
